headline: Google positions new smart glasses as more private than Meta's
summary: Google is marketing its new smart glasses around privacy, explicitly contrasting them with Meta's glasses, which have drawn criticism and the nickname "pervert glasses" over privacy concerns. Coverage describes Google's privacy messaging as attention-seeking, while noting that some of the underlying policies are genuinely good.

claims.statement: Google is positioning its new smart glasses as the more privacy-minded option compared with Meta's.

sources.quote: Eager to separate its glasses from Meta’s offerings, Google is positioning its frames as the more privacy-minded option.
Google really needs you to know it cares about smart glasses privacy
